MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Elevation
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows elevation. Colors run from sea level to 9000 m. Higher ground uses the top color.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Hilliness
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows terrain hilliness from flat (green) to impassable mountains (dark red). Useful for understanding movement costs and settlement options.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Biome
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows biome distribution with selection dropdown.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Rock types
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows where a chosen natural rock type occurs. Pick the rock from the button.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Temperature
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows annual average temperature using Earth-scale ranges (-50°C to +50°C) with enhanced climate data.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Seasonal Temperature Variation
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows seasonal temperature amplitude - how much temperature varies between summer and winter. Continental interiors and high latitudes show extreme variation.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Continental vs Maritime
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows how maritime or continental a tile is. Blue is maritime, red-brown continental. With the new climate, ocean air is carried along the wind, mostly by the winter wind: land downwind of an ocean stays maritime far inland, and a coast with the wind blowing offshore is continental almost to the shore. Otherwise the value falls with distance from the coast, and a large enclosed sea adds a shorter blue band.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Monsoon intensity
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows seasonal monsoon moisture boost (additional mm/year in monsoon zones). Tropical and subtropical regions with ocean proximity and seasonal wind reversal.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Rainfall
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows annual rainfall using Earth-scale ranges (0mm to 8000mm) with enhanced precipitation modeling.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Aridity Index
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows the aridity index (rainfall/PET ratio) - a scientific measure of moisture availability. Values below 0.2 indicate arid regions, above 1.0 indicate humid regions.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Initial Basins (Debug)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows pre-fill/spill topographic basins based on initial sinks. Red tiles indicate sink locations.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Merged Basins (Debug)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows merged basins after fill-and-spill simulation. Terminal lakes are Red, Spilling lakes/outlets are Green.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: River Systems
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows aggregated river systems (major watersheds) after small basins have been merged. Each color represents a major drainage system composed of multiple elementary basins.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Drainage Type (Debug)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Classifies tiles as Exorheic (Blue), Endorheic (Orange), Terminal Lake (Red), or Spilling Lake (Green).

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: River flow (RP2)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Rain-weighted flow on RP2 drainage. Brighter tiles carry more water. Rivers are drawn from this.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Incoming moisture
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Moisture arriving at each tile, in millimeters, before it rains out.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Condensation
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Moisture that rains out at each tile, in millimeters.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Remaining moisture
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Moisture still in the air after this tile, in millimeters.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Drying ratio
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Remaining moisture divided by incoming moisture. 1 means the air kept its moisture.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Current temperature
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Ocean-current temperature anomaly in degrees. Warm currents are one end of the scale, cool currents the other.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Convergence
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Rising air is positive. Sinking air is negative.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Daily temperature range
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Estimated mean daily temperature range in degrees. Evaporation uses this only when that debug switch is on.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Flow Accumulation (Topology)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows drainage areas from topology run (uniform flow). Darker blue indicates more upstream tiles; reveals river paths and wetland locations.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Flow Accumulation (Climate)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Tier 2: Shows climate-driven flow (rainfall × area). Only has data when Advanced Hydrology is enabled.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Maritime air share
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Annual share of air that arrived from the ocean along the wind.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Precipitable water
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Annual-mean column water vapour W in millimeters.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Land evaporation (ET)
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Annual Fu-Budyko land evapotranspiration in millimeters.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Ocean water share
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Share of moisture supplied directly from ocean evaporation versus recycled land evaporation.

MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.label: Swampiness
MapModeFramework.MapModeDef.description: Shows swampiness score based on drainage, climate, and terrain. Green areas indicate swamps, marshes, and wetlands.
